name: Bento Board UI Grid Engine
description: Composes complex interfaces into Apple- and Linear-style modular Bento Boards. Emphasizes visual rhythm, asymmetric card proportions, and self-contained content units.

grid_foundation: Use 2D CSS Grid tracks (repeat(3, 1fr) or repeat(4, 1fr))
Use uniform gutters across the entire board (typically 16px or 24px)

asymmetry_and_hierarchy.2x1: Wide feature card with short horizontal graph or copy
asymmetry_and_hierarchy.1x2: Tall vertical preview or contextual feed

self_contained_compartments: Every cell must function as an independent, readable compartment with internal hierarchy (Title -> Metric/Graphic -> Caption)
Internal padding must be uniform across all cards (p-5 or p-6 / 20–24px)
Use generous rounded borders (rounded-2xl or rounded-3xl / 16–24px radius)

surface_contrast.dark_mode: True black or dark slate canvas (#0A0A0C) with elevated card surfaces (#141418 or #1A1A22) and subtle borders (border-white/10)
surface_contrast.light_mode: Soft off-white canvas (#F5F5F7) with pure white card surfaces (#FFFFFF) and hairline borders (border-black/5)

deliverables: Layout Blueprint: Text-based grid schematic showing cell row/column spans
Component Implementation: Semantic HTML/JSX using Tailwind CSS grid classes
Responsive Breakpoints: 1-col on mobile (<640px), 2-col on tablet, full multi-span on desktop (>=1024px)
